surface_fix.what: label the September contested names the classifier decides and measure the bar
surface_fix.exact_change: 11 frozen labels (winner, other, name, label) and the bar line 'contested bar: decided N of 11, wrong N of N'

items.root_cause: the contested classifier reads only the head noun of the name, so it confirms a product whose head names the winner even when the FORM differs from the commodity's label (fried apples in a jar against fresh apples; a flavoured rice pouch against dry white rice). With no labelled bar nothing stopped 'contested' from being added to the deciding kinds, where each such confirm would be written to match-verdicts.json and become REVIEWED for the soundness audit for good.

root_fix.what: a kind may DECIDE only when its labelled bar holds, and that rule now reads the resolver's own deciding-kinds list rather than a copy: adding 'contested' while the frozen September labels carry a wrong confirm turns the resolver's self-test red
root_fix.exact_change: Test-ContestedMayDecide(kinds, wrongCount) plus three cases: MUST FIRE (coverage, semantic, contested refused at wrong 2 of 11), CLEAN TWIN (the shipped list read from resolve-match-worklist.ps1 passes), CLEAN TWIN (the release reading is right 4 of 4)

blast_radius.measured_by: no rule, no verdict and no route changes: the edit is fixtures in test-match-worklist.ps1, which resolve-match-worklist.ps1 -SelfTest relays; the live resolver's deciding kinds are unchanged (coverage, semantic)
blast_radius.risk: none to the board. A future fix to the head-noun rule that stops confirming fried apples will turn the must-fire's premise false; that is the moment to re-measure the bar and consider adding contested.

proof.must_fire_case: MUST FIRE contested added to the deciding kinds is refused while its labelled bar has a wrong decision (Bakers Corner Fried Apples IN Cinnamon confirmed to fresh apples): wrong 2 of 11
proof.clean_twin: CLEAN TWIN the resolver as shipped passes the same gate (deciding kinds read from its source: coverage,semantic); CLEAN TWIN the contested release reading is right on every labelled release: 4 of 4

prevention.what: the emitter's -Accept is where a contested name becomes REVIEWED without a per-name reading; that is the upstream producer of both the silence (a blessed wrong route never pages) and the return (arrivals nobody decided come back as new-contested on the next day a non-accepted run sees them)
